title: Chargeable TechWorks Work in the Spend Circle Points Are Earned On
content:
## Chargeable work brought into the spend

Chargeable work carried out on the agreement the profile holds with
Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair is brought into the spend reward points on a Northbeam Circle
Membership are earned on.

| Standing of the agreement | Labour charged on it in the month ending on the handling day | What is brought into the spend |
|---|---|---|
| Completed | Some | The labour charged on that agreement in that month |
| Completed | None | The least labour billed on that service at its labour rate |
| Any other standing | Any | Nothing |

Where the agreement stands completed and labour was charged on it in the month ending on the handling day,
the labour charged in that month is brought into the spend. Where that agreement stands completed and no
labour was charged on it in that month, the least labour billed on that service at its labour rate is brought
into the spend. Where neither of those holds, nothing is brought into the spend for work, and 0.00 goes in on
this account.

## The window and the two amounts

The window here is the month ending on the handling day, not a longer one: labour charged two months ago does
not reach the first reading, and an agreement standing completed with nothing charged in that month brings in
the least labour of the service instead. Both amounts belong to the service the agreement is handled under
rather than to the Circle tier.

## Cases

An agreement standing completed with 245.00 of labour charged in the month ending on the handling day brings
245.00 into the spend. The same agreement with its labour charged three months ago brings in the least labour
billed on that service at its labour rate. An agreement standing dispatched brings in nothing, however much
labour stands charged on it.
